content:
All 6 retrying orders are exclusively from supplier "Al-Noor Trading", while E14 shows other suppliers (Red Sea Parts, Riyadh Supplies, Najd Logistics) have invoices processed successfully. This pattern rules out a bad_deploy of worker (which would break all invoices) and points squarely to bad_input: Al-Noor Trading changed their invoice layout, which the worker cannot parse.
